text: Handling Unauthorised VAS Subscription Complaints Document ID: SOP_C10_VAS_DISPUTE Category: C10 — Value Added Services (VAS) Department: Product Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To ensure unauthorised Value Added Service (VAS) charges are investigated and refunded consistently, per consent-based subscription regulations. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Pull the VAS activation log for the disputed service, including channel (SMS/USSD/WAP click/app) and timestamp. If consent cannot be clearly evidenced, approve a full refund of charges for the disputed service. Deactivate the VAS immediately regardless of the consent outcome, if the customer requests deactivation. Log the activation channel for pattern analysis — repeated unconsented activations from a single VAS partner are escalated to Legal/Compliance. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Unresolved cases are automatically flagged
title: Handling Unauthorised VAS Subscription Complaints
